title: Humanitarian figure
description: A drawn humanitarian figure with its data table: 3W matrix or map, needs against coverage, pipeline projection, funding status, staff incident timeline or access constraints map. Numbers are drawn from data, never generated as pixels.

source.description: Where the numbers come from, for example '3W reports received by 12:00'

hideTable.description: Leave out the data table beside the figure

figures.description: The figure to draw as { main: { kind, data } }. Kinds: humanitarian_3w_matrix, humanitarian_3w_map, humanitarian_needs_coverage, humanitarian_pipeline, humanitarian_funding_bar, humanitarian_security_timeline, humanitarian_access_map.
